findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_q_verdict_v1__dao_proposal_preview · Private data: x402_q_verdict_v1__base_token_verdict_v3, x402_q_verdict_v1__eth_mainnet_token_verdict, x402_q_verdict_v1__eth_mainnet_token_verdict_preview · Public sink: x402_q_verdict_v1__dao_proposal_preview, x402_q_verdict_v1__dao_proposal_verdict.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x402_q_verdict_v1__dao_proposal_preview · Private data: x402_q_verdict_v1__base_token_verdict_v3, x402_q_verdict_v1__eth_mainnet_token_verdict, x402_q_verdict_v1__eth_mainnet_token_verdict_preview · Public sink: x402_q_verdict_v1__dao_proposal_preview, x402_q_verdict_v1__dao_proposal_verdict

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
